title: Zay Flowers: I'm not focused on contract, but don't want to leave Baltimore

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Zay Flowers: I'm not focused on contract, but don't want to leave Baltimore
sources.description: The Seahawks set a new standard for the wide receiver market when they signed Jaxon Smith-Njigba to a contract extension last month and one of the players who could be impacted by the deal is Ravens wideout Zay Flowers.
